$run_id.//: Backend + agent write via the Admin SDK (rules bypassed). Clients get read-only access to a run only if they own it, established by the backend-written meta/lecturer_id. No client writes.

$chat_id.//: Processing status for a chat's attachments, so the composer can subscribe instead of polling an HTTP endpoint every 2.5s. Same ownership model as agentRuns: the backend writes meta/lecturer_id via the Admin SDK and the rule reads it back. Read-only for clients; the Firestore document remains the source of truth.
